comment: Mc-incremental EMC values (#41, #47, #55, #59, #68, #72, #81). GENERATED by docs/research/emc-pricing/generate.py from hand_values.json, rarity.json and ore_yields.json there: do not edit by hand, edit those and re-run it. ProjectE applies this file after its datapack defaults, so these values win. It pins only what no recipe can make from cheaper things (#72): hand values, every raw material's unit on its dust or gem (rarity or ProjectE's defaults; ingots, plates and blocks derive from it, #81), the late-tier floors, rocks and every ore-processing form at their expected yield (a raw ore block at 9 raw ores), what the game can't derive (pinned at a recipe's ingredient cost), filled buckets (empty bucket + fluid), and the ProjectE tag defaults the Pack overrides (nether star, blaze rod). ProjectE and the Prestige mod's GT recipe mapper derive everything else. The Transmutation Tablet is 0: the Prestige mod hands it out. See docs/pocs/poc-1.md.
